title: PersonaPlexParams
description: PersonaPlex conditions on a voice prompt and a text role prompt before full-duplex speech-to-speech. voice_code is one of NATF0-3, NATM0-3, VARF0-4, VARM0-4. voice_prompt is that code plus .pt. text_prompt sets role and persona. The public prompting guide trains persona shaping, not content injection. gated is always true: nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1 is a gated Hugging Face repo and the weights are not in this package. sample_rate is 24 kHz.

text_prompt.description: Free-text role prompt passed as --text-prompt. There is no separate role enum.
